-- intro: Gravity Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to manipulate gravity.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to manipulate gravity at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. The user can decrease gravity, allowing them to make themselves and other things float. The user can also greatly increase the effects of gravity on the target, slamming them into the ground. Additionally, the user can use gravity to compress an object from any side, shaping it into a desired form. The user can also manipulate gravity on specific objects or body parts. By increasing the gravity on said object, it causes the attacks to deal more damage due to the added weight. By decreasing the gravity on said object, it causes the attacks to be unleashed faster because it weighs less. The user can also utilize gravity to warp space and generate miniature black holes.
-- spell pages: Presence of the Demon King; Heavy Infighting; Heavy Infighting Gladiator; Gravity Singularity; Evil God's Pressure Craft
